subject: Next steps — global demo scheduling and rotating calendar baton
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@novacorp.com>, Amira Hussein <amira@meditech.co.uk>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — global demo scheduling and rotating calendar baton

Hi Tom / Amira —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap: NovaCorp is evaluating a dedicated inference path for your internal search and analytics pipelines, and we agreed the next step is a technical deep dive/demo that includes your infra team (networking + security) and an engineer who owns latency budgets.

To keep this practical across orgs in US / EU / APAC, I pulled together three rotating-week options so we don’t always force one time zone to bend. Attached: MA-demo-agenda.pdf (outline) and timezone-options.ics (proposed slot blocks).

Proposed cadence (shortlist — pick one):
- Option A (three-week rotation): Week 1 = US morning (10:00–11:00 PT), Week 2 = EU midday (14:00–15:00 BST), Week 3 = APAC late afternoon (17:00–18:00 SGT)
- Option B (two-week rotation): Week 1 = US/EU overlap slot (16:00–17:00 BST / 08:00–09:00 PT), Week 2 = APAC-friendly (11:00–12:00 SGT)
- Option C (fixed rolling window): alternate weekdays so every region gets one prime slot per month

Please reply with which option you prefer and any hard constraints (e.g., no Wednesdays before 09:00 PT). If you want, Ben can draft a calendar schedule and share a recurring invite set for a six-week pilot.

Next steps I propose (we can adjust):
1) You confirm preferred rotation (A / B / C) and list attendees for the first deep dive.
2) We schedule three candidate dates (one per slot) and lock the recurring invite for the pilot.
3) Redwood brings a runtime engineer + a short demo that hits: latency profile, routing/fallbacks, and KV caching behavior.

Thanks — I'll hold a couple of provisional times until I hear back.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
[m] +1 (415) 555-0192

We leaned toward Option A (three-week rotation) on the call because it spreads the inconvenience. A couple constraints from our side:

- For the APAC-friendly week, we need a slot after 16:00 SGT so our Tokyo office can join.

Suggested first three candidate dates (please convert to your time):
- Week 1 (US morning): Tue, Oct 5, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Week 2 (EU midday): Thu, Oct 14, 14:00–15:00 BST
- Week 3 (APAC late afternoon): Wed, Oct 20, 17:30–18:30 SGT

If those look good, we can lock them and add the relevant attendees. Also, would appreciate Ben including a short note on expected participant roles (who from Redwood should be at which session).

Notes:
- For each regional week we recommend a focused agenda (30–40 min demo + 20–30 min Q&A). We’ll label invites "Deep dive — NovaCorp (US week)" / "(EU week)" / "(APAC week)" so attendees know which session to join.
- Role mapping: Redwood runtime engineer (deep config/routing), solutions engineer (prompting/workflows), and an account owner (to capture next steps). Ben will take US-week ownership, Marissa will own EU-week coordination, Maya will own APAC-week invites.
- Pilot length: 6-week recurring with the three-week rotation repeated twice; after week 6 we’ll review and either continue or adjust cadence.

I’ll draft calendar invites and share three provisional events (as Maya suggested). If the dates Tom proposed work, I’ll send invites with "provisional" until we get final headcounts.
